data.title: 提丰 · 煎好的蘑菇先给你尝
data.description: 家里小厨房，提丰穿梅紫棉裙与燕麦色围裙，把煎好的蘑菇装进小碟递给你。她微微侧头等你评价，另一只手把锅铲搁在台面上；平底锅和切好的蔬菜都留在灶边。
data.action: 把装着煎蘑菇的小碟递向镜头，等待评价
data.promptProse: Typhon offers a small plate of sauteed mushrooms in the home kitchen, tilting her head to await the viewer's response. Her plum cotton dress and oatmeal apron face the eye-level medium camera as her other hand sets the spatula down. The pan and cut vegetables remain beside the stove. Warm pendant light brightens the plate and apron pocket, laying utensil shadows along the counter.
